services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: kyle hobson
reviews.text: We took my mother’s Cadillac to them to have the oil leaks fixed. They determined the oil leak was coming from the valve cover gaskets.they also had to replace her headlights because some of the signal lights wasn’t working properly. After getting the car back it was discovered that it had more than just the valve cover gaskets leak. On their request we brought it back. It took a while but they went to bat for us and fixed ever leak. They also did not charge us anything extra. I got to say they were honest, kind and went over and beyond the call of service. I’ve been affiliated with the car business for over 45 years and they are first class in my book. Thank you guys for all y’all did.

reviews.author: Joey Searcy
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about my experience at Butler’s. I noticed my radiator cracked and leaking coolant when pulling into a local hotel during a long road trip. This was not ideal being I was on a schedule to attend a family wedding the next day. A hotel staff member recommended Butler’s, I call them and told them my situation and urgency. They were extremely nice and told me to get the truck in to the shop and they would do their best to get me on the road again and that they did. After dropping my truck off, they provided me with a ride back to the hotel and replaced my radiator while I got some much needed rest. They called me back a few hours later with the truck fixed and came to the hotel to pick me up. This shop went above and beyond with customer service and kept me on schedule. Can’t thank them enough for everything and would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Brent Leigh
reviews.text: Went to get tires rotated. My tires were in pretty bad shape, I knew this before I went. They helped us out with new tires at a real good price. They will do all of my oil changes and service from now on. Super nice people.

reviews.author: Will Bayless
reviews.text: I blew a tire on I-85, rolled into their shop without an appointment, they put me right in their shop and took care of me. They only charged me for the tire but for free they mounted+balanced the tire, put a new lug nut on and torqued my tire. They also filled up my spare tire and put it back in its place with me having to ask them to!

reviews.author: Loretta Allison
reviews.text: Butler's is the best place to go for all your automotive needs. Jackie new exactly what was wrong with my truck just starting it up and listen to it then the dinosis told the rest and they got right to it within the next day and the women in the office were very friendly and got back to me with the information I needed to go ahead with getting the work done.. The worst party is, I had it at another mechanics shop for 3 weeks, and he could never figure out what was wrong with it couldn't even get to it.It was a waste of time and

reviews.author: Beacon
reviews.text: We broke down and we're towed here. They understood our misfortune and got us in line immediately and fixed our car a day later even though they were very busy. We were lucky we found them. We dont live near them as we were just passing by the city when we broke down but I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: David Underwood
reviews.text: Been going to Butler's Auto for many years with many different vehicles; the mechanics there are very good and it is the best place in Kings Mountain by far to have your car serviced. Reasonably priced and always good, honest, quality work.

reviews.author: Shannon Souther
reviews.text: Without a doubt, the best experience I’ve ever had with an automotive repair shop. These guys are consummate professionals and can handle the big jobs better than the dealership. My truck went in for a full motor replacement and replacement of both turbos. I couldn’t be Happier with the quality of the work and how clean they left my vehicle. They went the extra mile on several things that really weren’t even required of them. To me, that shows a level of character that’s hard to find in today’s marketplace. As far as I’m concerned, this is the only place you should take your vehicle if you live anywhere close to Kings of Mountain North Carolina

reviews.author: Jeff Maddix
reviews.text: About a month ago I had a vehicle with a broken hub out in Kings Mountain, about an hour from home. Butler's was recommended to me so I took my truck there. It was Friday afternoon and I was told it would be Monday before they could look at it. They called with a quote by 10am Monday morning and it was fixed and ready Monday afternoon. It is a work vehicle for my business, so getting back on the road so quickly was important. Thanks to Butler's Tire $ Auto Service!!

reviews.author: Joann
reviews.text: I was traveling to Charlotte when my car randomly stopped accelerating near King Mountain. I was frantic, I Googled auto repair shops near me. Butler’s was the first to pop up and I looked at their great rating. I called them and told them what was going on. At the time they didn’t have anyone that could come to me but they offered a tow company to call. They confirmed that I could turn the car off and retry to start it to see if it would be drivable. It worked! I was able to drive to their location. They checked my car out immediately and let me know that the throttle body will likely need to be replaced. They were able to turn off my check engine light. The nice gentleman said I would be just fine to continue to my destination and get back home. He gave me some suggestions. I would definitely return if something was to happen to my vehicle near that area again and would definitely recommend them to anyone. I’m grateful they were able to assist right away and I made it to my appointment without a hitch. I don’t write reviews often but I wasn’t going to go to bed without letting everyone know the exceptional experience I had today.

reviews.author: sara Thomas
reviews.text: Amazing knowledgeable staff. My husband had an overheating engine issue while on route to Charlotte at midnight . He luckily was able to get off the exit and visit Butlers the next morning with his EV. They were honest, quick, and helpful. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Tina
reviews.text: They were great. I went in thinking I needed an alignment because my SUV was shaking so bad. So when I got there the lady came out and got my key and asked me a few questions about the shaking. Then her and the mechanic (& me) went out to inspect my tires. Low and behold, I had a big bubble in one of my tires. They could have easily just given me what I asked for and taken my money but they didn't and I'm grateful.

reviews.author: Kumar Lewis
reviews.text: I WOULD ONLY SUGGEST YOU TAKE YOUR VEHICLE TO BUTLER TIRE IF YOU HAVE A GOOD LAWYER. I bought my used vehicle from a dealer so I could have a safe vehicle to transport my family around in and it drove almost perfectly. Three weeks after I purchased it the check engine light came on so I took it to butler tire. I was told my vehicle would be ready in three days. Well, 2 whole weeks later my vehicle was finally ready for pickup and the reason I was given for it taking so long was because "there were cars on the lifts waiting for parts in the mail." Well apparently those parts never arrived because when I got my vehicle back there were cuts made into my dash and there was no reason for any cutting to be done on my vehicle. I went in for a simple check engine light. I was told it was my catalytic converter and the repair charge was $1300. After being informed of the repair cost and later noticing the cuts made in my dashboard, I immediately contacted the dealer who sold me the car and he told me to bring the vehicle back it might be something else. Well turns out there were two O2 sensors throwing the computer off because the check engine has been off ever since. However, numerous systems that worked perfectly the entire time prior to taking my vehicle to butler tire had started to fail almost immediately like door locks, and A.C. The only reasons I didn't return to Butler to complain were because I know if they are bold enough to steal my vehicle parts and exchange them for faulty ones, then they are obviously bold enough to lie about it. The only reason I didnt pursue the issue in court is because family has been rooted in Kings Mountain for generations operating businesses, and have the money for a better lawyer than i do.

reviews.author: Matti Bubar
reviews.text: My last review wasn't fake, went to your establishment and watched how you treated my roommate. Maybe learn to listen to customers more? And not just focus on getting money? We ended up taking the car to someone else and they listened and now is getting what she needs fixed done luckily BEFORE her engine dies. Good job assuming it's fake just because I didn't write anything on my last review. And before you say I didn't technically have my own car fixed. Keep in mind I rely on it to get places as well, so it not dying is important for me as well.

reviews.author: Altora Ware
reviews.text: They are the most friendly and accurate place to get all your car needs! The guy over the shop fixed my bumper for absolutely free after I had been quoted 300 dollars by other shops! Basically just to tighten up a bolt.... So kindness goes a long way with me! I went back the next morning and let Butlers do my brakes and spent some money with them! Honestly this place is an awesome place to go for all your car care needs and they aren't trying to drain your pockets... Thanks to the Butler Crew

reviews.author: ohana love
reviews.text: I sent my car here thinking it wouldn't take that long and it ended up taking 2 weeks and when I eventually had it taken somewhere else even they could tell they did nothing except cause more problems. That environment was very hostile and it felt like it might have been discriminative. Their customer service is atrocious and I have never been talked to the way they talked to me since I was a child. If I am being honest save your money and go somewhere else all they caused were more problems and drama. Would not recommend not even to people I don't like.

reviews.author: Alnisa Washington
reviews.text: Initially the service/repair on my car was decent until I made it about a mile out then I noticed a loud knocking sound. I called to inform them and was told they would look at it when I returned that Friday. The mechanic claimed that it had something to do with idling and that it was normal. Although my car NEVER made that sound before I brought it in. It still makes this terrible sound 5 days out. To top it all off the Heavy set lady at the front desk quoted me a price on an inspection and when it was time to pay see gave me a different price. She lied and said I never gave her my registration which is why there was a mix up. This obviously isn't true because they wouldn't even do an inspection without your registration. I expressed to her that it was not good business to quote one thing and change it to another especially when it was at no fault of the customer. With all of that being said I paid it but it still did not sit right with me. As I was leaving I decided to call back to speak with the owner but could not get through because they blocked my number. I called from my daughters phone, they answered. Before I could speak my peace after spending almost $200 the owner got on the phone and proceeded to tell me that EVERYBODY knows the price for this particular service. I was of course surprised at the way I was treated as a customer. He says I'm not gonna sit here and argue with you just come back and get your money, I did just that. When I arrived they pretended to know who I was and what the issue was so I had to explain it once again. Instead of handing me the money back he ( a younger white man with a salt & pepper beard) threw it down on the counter to clearly show disrespect toward me. My experience here was one one I will NEVER encounter again because I will never use them again. Hopefully no one will ever have to experience Butler's Tire & Auto's lack of professionalism and disrespect as I have.

reviews.author: Douglas Maloon
reviews.text: On my way up 85, on a 12 hour drive, I got a puncture. Stopped at a major tire chain, and when I asked if they could quickly get me back on the road, they said it wouldn’t be quick. I headed up the road a bit to Butler’s, and they immediately got to work trying to help. And when I say “immediately”, I mean I hadn’t finished my sentence to the receptionist before someone jumped up and walked me back to my car to take a look. After it became clear a patch wouldn’t do, they found a used tire that fit, balanced and put it on. This, with all the service bays full - they were busy that day, and pulled someone off a job just to get me taken care of. So far, great service. But when it came time to pay, they wouldn’t take my money! We argued, politely, and they said they wouldn’t charge me for the tire, just the service. Even then it was difficult to pay them what it was worth for getting me back on the road so quickly. These folks are good people who saved me a longer drive, and did it graciously. The tire got us home safely, and is still going strong. I can’t say enough good things about the people at Butler. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Trevor Alexander
reviews.text: Just had 5 new tires installed on my Jeep for a much better price than everyone else. The tires look great and have no vibrations, so the balancing is perfect. They also picked it up from my work (close to their shop) and brought it back for me. I highly recommend them for their professionalism and amazing pricing.

reviews.author: Ryan Howard
reviews.text: My right brake light was out on a road trip and a kind gentleman fixed it on short notice, so we could safely get back on the road home. The price also was more than fair. I recommend them highly! Thank you for the great experience.

reviews.author: Woody Sandlin
reviews.text: Great People! We were traveling through Kings Mtn and had a couple of unexpected issues. They got us back on the road in no time. Fair, Honest, Friendly. Thank you!

reviews.author: Sue Brabham
reviews.text: Always had no problems with receiving service in a time matter and from very knowledgeable people. However not the case today! My car was taken there 5 days ago and I told them I probably needed a battery or started. 5 days later I’m calling and begging for service. Jackie went above and beyond to help me get a battery in my car! Brand new building, front office personal has gone from competent knowledgeable and customer service oriented to totally clueless!! 2 visits ago it was 13 days to change a fuse! If this is now the norm I may have to take my business elsewhere, sadly.

reviews.author: Richard Head
reviews.text: While they were repairing my transmission, which they did a great job of, my car was damaged. While they eventually did fix it, they tried to pay only for parts, not paint or installation. They do good work, but I'll be going elsewhere from now on. Customer service and taking responsibility is too important to ignore.

reviews.author: Amanda Ray
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would. I went in for a tune up and they told me I had no oil in my car and needed a new motor. Which was false. So they wouldn't even give me a tune up. Just told me he could check on me a new motor. I added the amount of oil I was instructed to and it almost locked my motor up because I had way too much oil in my car. I believe he just didn't want to do the work it took to do a tune up or just wanted to make money off me. Thank God I know enough about cars not to believe him. I will never go back tbhere.

reviews.author: Harry Bruce
reviews.text: Has my vehicle jacked from from Courage Kia in Gastonia , i arrived at Butlers Automotive without an appointment never been there before got me right in and recalibrated my steering sensor and only charged me $50.00 . The KIA dealership was going to charge me 450.00 to do the same procedure !! Thanks guys for helping me in a bind , i will definately be back to give this place my business !!! All the staff was very friendly and inviting i feel like they cared about helping me fix my problem i was having !!

reviews.author: Quan E
reviews.text: Pretty great company, had my car for almost a month. I have a Volkswagen Jetta so parts take forever to come. But they have been great trying to fix my car and they went out of their way to fix my cars such as my bumper and different things in my car that I’m thankful for. I highly recommend. I don’t do much reviews but these people deserves one

reviews.author: Kara Forester
reviews.text: Our car broke down on I-85 at 10:30 pm at the end of a holiday weekend over 100 miles from home. The tow truck knew of this place, so he brought the car here and took us to a hotel. The next morning we called and they were already about to look at it. By the time we had breakfast and walked to the shop, he had finished the repair and we were able to get on our way quickly. The rates were reasonable and they didn't try to do anything extra to the car. I wish we had a shop like this closer to home!

reviews.author: Susan Foe
reviews.text: Just wanted to give this shop 5 STARS. Traveling out of state my headlights went out. They jumped on it right away and fixed my problem immediately. I transport pets cross country for many military personnel. When something happens, it’s so difficult to get service. Not here!!!! What a great, friendly, and professional group of people. Thanks so much from me and the pets on board. Totally appreciate your thoughtfulness.

reviews.author: Karla Stamey
reviews.text: Best Service in town!! They always go above and beyond to help us with our vehicle repairs and maintenance !! Bryan is the best, he never fails to impress us with his customer service and he always delivers great quality work !!

reviews.author: Marylene
reviews.text: I'm going to have tires put on my truck, they have the best deal. The ladies in the office are very nice.

reviews.author: Gabrielle Dearman (Gabbi)
reviews.text: I got new tires and an alignment for about half the price everyone else was asking. After a small hiccup, I also got my brakes done there and the owner outdid himself making sure I was satisfied before I left. Always talk to them if you have questions or concerns, because they are willing to listen and negotiate.

reviews.author: Lisa Rayfield
reviews.text: Not having good results so far. Had appt to drop my Jeep off at 900 on Monday, its 5 oclick pm on Wednesday. Called and they acted like they had no idea why it was there. Even left a message on Monday what needed to be looked at along with talking on Friday telling them while making my appt.update. fixed and very pleased

reviews.author: Kelvin McClure
reviews.text: Was traveling from Atlanta back to Charlotte and a problem occurred with my radiator. I pulled over in Kings Mountain and happened to stumble across Butler's and they welcomed me with open arms. They immediately admitted my vehicle and tried to repair the issue. The mechanics even stayed past closing to make sure everything was efficient with my vehicle before I got back on the road. I would definitely recommend Butler's Auto to anyone who wants speedy, inexpensive, and quality service done to their vehicles.

reviews.author: A drink before the war
reviews.text: Great shop with awesome service! Very honest people who are dedicated to making sure you and your vehicle are well taken care of. Shop is fast pace but they do things right and ALWAYS follow up. So thankful to have such a wonderful shop in Kings Mountain

reviews.author: Misha Coble
reviews.text: I use Butlers for all my vehicle maintenance. They have always been good to me. Prices are reasonable and the mechanics know their stuff. I have been using Butlers since I moved to km 24 years now. Thanks Mike

reviews.author: John Gibson
reviews.text: Mr. Butler is a good man, has always fixed my vehicles and serviced them well and ensured that I was satisfied and informed about what my vehicles needed when they needed more than just the regular servicing. I know people say you cannot trust some professions, but I have trusted Mr. Butler and his people and they have never in the years let me down. I notice when I am there that he treats the least among us as well as the better place persons who use his business services. When one observes true attempts to do right in an owner of a business, that is a rarity in America.

reviews.author: Stephanie Rinkowski
reviews.text: I had the best experience I've ever had at a garage here! They went above and beyond to help me and my family! I highly recommend anyone to take their vehicles here! I will NEVER go anywhere else! The mechanic is amazing (Jay) and everyone there treats you like family!

reviews.author: Chad Wright
reviews.text: Great service and really good people. They can do pretty much anything you need done and at more reasonable prices than the dealer.

reviews.author: Michele Pierce
reviews.text: Because I’m a woman they felt but I didn’t know what I was talking about. I took my car to a different garage and the mechanic they told me that I was right on point. Maybe they need to have some kind of classes to treat women a little bit better than what they do.

reviews.author: Noah Webb
reviews.text: Took my vehicle here to have my engine swapped. They swapped it but apparently didn't get the timing right. I blew a starter a couple months later due to it. Took it back, told them the starter went bad and I assumed the timing was off. They replaced the starter but still having the same timing issues. Check engine light comes on related to the timing, but only the check engine light. I go to pick it up after they've "fixed" it and suddenly I have a terrible sounding undriveable car. I suspect the tensioner is loose. I take it back again, and they keep it for over a week to look at it, do nothing, and then tell me I need a new engine. "Repairs" aside, their customer service is awful. **EDIT After the fact, Butlers did offer to do the labor for free if I were to supply a new engine. It was at least some consolation. **EDIT Tensioner had basically exploded. Costed me some money to get it repaired (at a different shop) but much less than a new engine would've.

reviews.author: Michel Trabue
reviews.text: Mr butler is a nice guy and a good business man who employs some decent mechanics prices are not terrible. The only reason he didn't get 5 stars is not because of the work but the prices could be a little cheaper. Expect most repairs to be 90-100 $ an hour which is an average price .

reviews.author: Maggie Scruggs
reviews.text: Excellent customer service! Brian called throughout the time they had my car and gave me detailed info about what was going on and what was needed for my car. Great communication!

reviews.author: Charlie Murray
reviews.text: Put a head gasket and timing belt on my CRV and did a great job. Stayed in contact with me through out the whole process. Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Chris Shirah
reviews.text: Had a flattened tailpipe on the ambulance. Stopped to see if they had a couple tools we could borrow to get it opened enough to get back to our station. The guys came out and got it opened back up for us. Great service!

reviews.author: Orriel Ferguson
reviews.text: My car was sent here by the dealership I purchased the car from. I picked it up myself a few days later. The car was not fixed and one of my brand new tires was missing. They replaced it with a bald tire no one said a word. I would not recommend this place.

reviews.author: Christopher Wall
reviews.text: Knowledgeable and friendly staff. We were in from Texas and had some issues with our truck. They took care of us right away and the price was more than fair. So glad we met these folks.

reviews.author: Juan Pablo Robledo
reviews.text: Went in for a simple vehicle inspection. Waited for nearly an hour. Nobody informed me the inspection was done until some lady saw my ticket just laying on the counter, I asked where the keys where and she couldnt find them. They left them in the car out in the parking lot where anybody could have taken it, except the whole time I had been waiting they left the key on and all the electronics were running. Needless to say when I went to crank the car it would not start, then they said I might have a bad battery, even though it had started up fine in the cold morning. I would not bring your vehicle here for any reason. Rude staff. Place smells. The whole place is filled with people I'm sure voted for Trump

reviews.author: Tim K. Hardin
reviews.text: Had a flat tire and took it in to see if it could be patched/plugged. They were able to get me in and out in about an hour. Service was awesome and cost was reasonable. Employees were friendly and professional!

reviews.author: Teresa Jones
reviews.text: They were friendly and helpful. The waiting area was clean and comfortable. I didn't need the restroom but I would think as nice as it was. There's a good chance they have one.

reviews.author: Becca Lamb
reviews.text: HORRIBLE do not trust these reveiws i did and its costing me!!! towed my car here and he told me he would get to it right away 4 days go by and he told me everyday he was about to look at it but never did... then without even really looking at it he told me he thinks its the transmission... i know it is not my transmission cause my transmission is in great condition... called another shop explained what was wrong with it and he knew without even looking at it and said he was supposed to be off that friday and saturday and told me he would work them so i can get my car back asap now that is great customer service!!! so i towed it yet again to another shop... it ended up being a sensor!!! And this man was telling me there was something "really bad" wrong with it and had me worried about my transmission... very shady and obviously lazy if anyone has went here and had excellent service then your lucky and i guess its hit or miss with this place but i wouldnt take the chance cause you may end up like me a week without a car and paying twice for a tow truck for a simple fix.

reviews.author: Shawn Sandefur
reviews.text: The Owner went out of his way to help one of my clients fix his truck and get it back on the road. He has the lowest prices anywhere and doesn't mind helping somebody and working with them. Hands down I would recommend recommend this shop over any shop In the Tri county area!!!

reviews.author: Steven Helms
reviews.text: Fantastic service and work! All problems and possibilities for repairs were clearly made and when I picked up the vehicle it was cheaper than expected. Very honest and great work!

reviews.author: Ted Allen
reviews.text: I want all to know how much I appreciate the fine service we get from Butler auto..Bryan Jackie and his son are awesome people..can highly recommend them ....many thanks Ted Allen

reviews.author: nathan kendall
reviews.text: After trying to tell me my check engine light was on because I needed an oil change i made them look at it again. My maintenance light was on for that but it comes on at 3k and I run synthetic so I know that wasnt it. I should have just gone and picked my truck up then. After keeping it over night I get a call the next day saying it was POSSIBLY the ECM an $800 repair but if that didn't fix the issue it was POSSIBLY a camshaft timing issue and could be a $2500 repair after paying the $800. So I was looking at a $100 oil change or a $3,300 repair. I could have googled all of that as nothing they told me was useful in ANYWAY as it didnt diagnose my problem or even tell me what kind of relative cost I was looking at! Then I was charged $50 for then to deduce all of that! I could have given my own guess and not paid $50 bucks to do it either! If you need anything more than an oil/tire/fluid change go somewhere else! I don't know what their tech certification requirements are but I'm thinking about applying. I could guess at mechanical issues all day too. What a joke! I promise I won't be back up the there nor will. any of my friends and family.

reviews.author: SashaDoll
reviews.text: Knowledgeable friendly staff who know their jobs and all interact together to give you the most efficient cost effective service. Bonus of on site diagnostic technicians means way less stress and decreased wait time .... Extra bonus. Very family oriented. Staff is a+++

reviews.author: Deseria Smith
reviews.text: They are very rude and Communication is definitely bad and nothing done on time I will not use them again I do not understand how they are 4 1/2 stars cause my experience here was bad. Yes the car is my mothers that y’all have the name is Jacklyn ward and we will be down there tomorrow hopefully we can have a talk about the rudeness she has experience with y’all.. thanks

reviews.author: Dara Bess
reviews.text: Bryan Butler was so nice and helpful even though it was closing time. He still helped me. His staff had left but he even took time to personally change my tire although it ran past closing time.

reviews.author: Mary Witt
reviews.text: We had a blowout on our camper tires while on the highway and Butlers fixed us up and got us back on the road very quickly.They did a fantastic job and went above and BeyondTo keep us safe.

reviews.author: Robyn Safrit
reviews.text: They put a new transmission in my mazda and gave me a good price. Anytime I tell someone it was only 2k and give them my car info they are amazed.

reviews.author: Amanda Braswell
reviews.text: This location stopped everything to help my family when we had car trouble traveling home to Atlanta from Charlotte. Kindness and genuine care. I highly recommend you bring your business here.

reviews.author: Candace Bowen
reviews.text: This group works together like a well oiled machine, they were personable and flexible at the same time. I was perfectly happy with their pricing as well. Can't beat Buter's Tire and Auto.

reviews.author: Christina Pope
reviews.text: They had my husbands car for more then a week and totally didnt fix the problem!! But charged us anyways, found out today they didnt even touch it

reviews.author: Ernest Stovall
reviews.text: Butlers Auto are the greatest Mr. BUTLER and his people are very professional and honest. I will always take my vehicles to Butlers the prices are the best around no one can top Butlers th e you are the Best.

reviews.author: MadHouse Artist
reviews.text: Jay is great, diagnosed the problem my previous mechanic couldn't find. We'll be back here for any future issues too. And back for oil changes and anything else. Nice people.

reviews.author: J Harrison
reviews.text: Ordered my tires in the morning, installed them in the afternoon! Very friendly staff and quick service. Will be calling them in the future for all my vehicles service and tire needs.

reviews.author: Wanda Carpenter
reviews.text: Wonderful people. They did a great job. Really good service!!! Nice, friendly. Made me feel comfortable. Prices great too.

reviews.author: Adam Clark
reviews.text: Broke my lug nut off and never said anything to me. Took over an hour to change one tire. Plus crushed my frame on the jeep because the guy didn't look before he jacked it up.

reviews.author: Amber Hyder
reviews.text: Thank you Brian for being on top of things and genuinely caring about your customers. It’s hard to find good people like this anymore these days.

reviews.author: Scott Scruggs
reviews.text: Very good service and showed great respect for my truck! The staff are all extremely nice to deal with.

reviews.author: Patricia A Hearvy
reviews.text: Very professional service and they promised to have my car back on the road in two days and they did. Thank you especially to Jay !

reviews.author: Keith Fite
reviews.text: Everyone very helpful and prices comparable, not over priced. I would highly recommend this business for any automotive needs.

reviews.author: Ruth McGonigal
reviews.text: Butler has had our truck for almost a month. We told them we needed our truck, because we are moving. Nothing has been done with as of yet.

reviews.author: Robert Walker
reviews.text: Good friendly people good service had to wait a little while but they were two men short but worth the wait.
